keyLimits.en: 12 Ask an Attorney sessions per year, 4 premium add-ons
36 Ask an Attorney sessions, 12 live attorney consultations, 7 premium add-ons
Unlimited Ask an Attorney and live attorney consultations, 10 premium add-ons

addOns.en: Business registration, EIN, registered agent, trademark filing, annual report and DBA filing sold as premium add-ons, count of included add-ons varies by plan

cautions.en: Annual price is billed as a lump sum once a year; the per-month figure shown for annual billing is a division of that annual charge, not a monthly invoice.
The 7-day trial converts automatically into a paid membership unless cancelled.

capabilities.en: Guided questionnaire to generate and customize hundreds of legal document templates (contracts, leases, NDAs, wills).
Unlimited AI legal Q&A and unlimited contract reviews included in every membership tier.
Unlimited e-signatures on documents created in the platform.
Access to on-call attorneys for legal questions and live consultations, with quotas that scale by tier.

limitations.en: Attorney consultation quotas are capped on the two lower tiers (Standard, Plus); only Pro offers unlimited consultations.
Business formation, registered agent and trademark services are sold as separate paid add-ons on top of the membership, not included by default.
Government filing fees (e.g. USPTO trademark fees of $250-$350 per class) are excluded from membership pricing.

reason.en: Similar guided-questionnaire legal document and business formation platform aimed at small businesses.
French competitor covering company formation and everyday legal documents for the same buyer profile.
Covers the e-signature portion of Rocket Lawyer's offer for teams that only need signing, not document drafting.
